name: schedule_maintenance
description: Schedule a maintenance activity for equipment with technician assignment, required permits (LOTO, confined space, hot work), production impact estimate, and safety requirements. Priority drives lead time (critical: same day, low: ~2 weeks).

maintenance_type.description: Type of maintenance (One of: preventive, predictive, corrective)

priority.description: Priority level (One of: critical, high, medium, low)

name: generate_work_order
description: Create a maintenance work order with sequenced task breakdown, parts list, labor and cost estimates, skills required, and approval status (critical/high priority auto-approves).

description.description: Description of the maintenance work needed

priority.description: Priority level (One of: critical, high, medium, low)

name: get_maintenance_history
description: Get historical maintenance records for equipment: work orders by type (preventive/predictive/corrective/emergency), cost and downtime summary, reactive maintenance percentage, and failure pattern analysis.

months.description: Number of months of history to retrieve (1-24) (Default: 12)

name: get_maintenance_calendar
description: Get the upcoming maintenance schedule for a facility: scheduled activities, weekly capacity, technician utilization, and scheduling conflicts.

days.description: Number of days ahead to show (1-90) (Default: 30)
